Sandbox_B47ANCEDAutoClean_RemoveTrashObj: Remove supported vanilla decorative trash objects during Clean Building and Clean Area. Dropped inventory items, containers and other props are untouched. Changing this setting cancels active jobs.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDAutoClean_TrashPickupSec: Time for each supported trash object, from 1 to 10 seconds. Default 2. Server authoritative in multiplayer. Changing this setting cancels active jobs.
